alina_description_eng: The Alon Tavor Industrial Park is an industrial area located in the domain of Emek Yizrael (Jezreel Valley) Regional Council, between Afula and Kfar Tavor. The Yizrael-Afula Industrial Areas Administration is held by the Municipality of Afula and Emek Yizrael Regional Council.

alina_description_eng: Yeruham is located in the area of the northern Negev mountains, south-east of Beersheba. The Yeruham Industrial Area is situated in western Yeruham and it contains various factories. In the center of the park there is an artificial lake, in the channel of the Revivim stream, called Yeruham Lake. East to the park there is an ancient well - Yeruham Well - that presumably functioned as a source of water for the adjacent fortress.
